claims.claim: Atlas serves four museums. Curators submit public object metadata and private draft notes to produce 80–120 word label drafts. Interactive preview targets a 750 ms p95 TTFT and 120 ms p95 ITL; overnight batch work has no interactive latency objective. Peak demand is 18 interactive and 45 batch arrivals per second. Prompts range from 64 to 2,048 tokens; outputs are capped at 160 tokens.
